name: Dan
summary: Jacob's fifth son, born to Bilhah, Rachel's maid. Jacob said Dan would judge his people and be like a snake beside the road.

key_moments.title: God Has Judged Me
key_moments.description: Rachel had no children, so she gave her maid Bilhah to Jacob. When Bilhah bore a son, Rachel named him Dan, saying God had judged her and heard her voice.

key_moments.title: Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: Dan went down to Egypt with his father Jacob and the whole family, along with his son Hushim.

key_moments.title: Jacob's Last Words
key_moments.description: Jacob said Dan would judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel. He would be like a snake beside the road that bites a horse's heels.
